key_points: Goldman Sachs reiterated Buy on META, citing a 'clearer catalyst path' following the Muse AI agent launch and a favorable legal settlement — a substantive, near-term positive.
High-profile investors are accumulating: Cathie Wood bought $27.9M of META and Bill Ackman increased his position, both signaling institutional conviction in the AI narrative.
Near-term selling pressure from sector-wide AI safety warnings is creating a dip-buying opportunity; the fundamental catalyst path (Muse, settlement, ad revenue strength) remains intact.
The $145B AI capex plan is a double-edged sword: heavy spending pressures margins short-term but underpins long-term growth optionality — data center political pushback adds incremental risk.
Threads surpassing X in engagement (per Zuckerberg) and a $55B ad quarter reinforce the core business strength supporting the bull case.
